title: Minimal index with automatic indexing on
description:
Performance rule — a field's index is set to Minimal while automatic indexing is still enabled. Minimal keeps the word index and drops the value index, but with automatic indexing on FileMaker rebuilds whatever a find needs anyway. The setting saves nothing predictable and usually documents an index that was cleared once and never reconsidered.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "ListFieldsWithIndexMinimalLocked" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Storage settings are read as intent. "Minimal" suggests a deliberate decision to keep the file small, while automatic indexing quietly undoes it on the next find — so neither the file size nor the search behaviour is what the setting promises.
rule.remediation: Decide which of the two is meant: turn automatic indexing off if the index really should stay minimal, or set the index to All if the field is searched.
